title: Send the six short /for doors in FlowWeb reply drafts (/for/teacher and five more) to the live door that fits, instead of a 404

source.ref: Owner decision 2026-11-11 (FlowWeb launch thread): FlowWeb's reply helper links hosts to /for/teacher, /for/studio, /for/venue, /for/music, /for/gathering and /for/maker, which the funnel registry never served (dynamicParams false, so 404).

detail: Six temporary redirects in next.config.ts: teacher to coaches-and-healers, studio to studios, venue to venues, music to event-hosts, gathering to clubs-and-groups, maker to local-businesses. None shadows a registry slug, and every destination is one, so lib/marketing/funnel-redirects.test.ts holds. Temporary so the short slugs stay free for real doors later.
